zh.summary: 用醫院比喻與訂餐案例理解 C4 四種觀察視角，再對照 Streamlit 參考程式，分清應用、程序內元件、部署實例、暫存與下載檔。
objectives: 以Container標示本課前端、Python程序與資料位置。
分開邏輯架構、部署實例與程序內元件。

readingGuide.startingPoint: architecture.md與工作坊reference/，紙筆或文字編輯器即可；不需安裝Docker。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 architecture.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: Container草圖與architecture.md文字正本，能對照實際參考程式與資料位置。

sections.heading: 從同一套系統選擇觀察距離
paragraphs: C4 Model 是一套用不同距離觀察軟體系統的方法：先看整個系統和外界的關係，再看有哪些程式、程式內部如何分工，最後看程式碼如何實作。它讓產品經理、軟體工程師、架構師及 AI Coding Agent 對同一套系統建立共同理解。
本篇掌握三個判讀原則：四層是四種觀察視角，不是四台電腦、四個服務或四個開發步驟；C4 Container 與 Docker Container 的意義不同；架構圖須對應實際程式、資料流與儲存位置，尚不存在的系統能力要明列為規劃。

sections.heading: 一、先用醫院比喻理解 C4
paragraphs: 想了解一家大型醫院如何運作，可以先看整間醫院與外界的關係，再看部門、部門內的分工，最後看具體設備。直接研究急診室某台儀器的電路板，無法先回答整體如何運作。C4 採用相似的逐步放大方式。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜由外向內的四種視角
blocks.description: 逐層縮排表示觀察範圍放大，不是四個依序執行步驟。醫院只是概念比喻，軟體層級不必與組織一一對應。

items.title: C1 — System Context｜最遠的視角
items.body: 醫院與病患、健保署、外部檢驗機構的關係。問：誰使用這間醫院？它依賴哪些外部機構？

items.title: C2 — Container
items.body: 掛號系統、病歷系統、檢驗資料庫。問：醫院內有哪些主要系統？各自負責什麼？

items.title: C3 — Component
items.body: 掛號系統內的預約、排程、通知模組。問：一個系統內部如何分工？

items.title: C4 — Code
items.body: 檢查時段的函式、資料模型、程式類別。問：具體如何實作？

blocks.caption: 表 1｜四個層級的問題
rows: 系統由哪些應用程式與資料儲存組成？
每個應用程式內部如何分工？

paragraphs: 四層使用四種詳細程度描述同一套系統，並不要求把系統切成四個部分。

sections.heading: 二、C4 Container 到底是什麼？
paragraphs: 在軟體工程中，Container 容易讓人想到 Docker。在 C4 Model 中，它指應用程式或資料儲存的架構邊界，例如瀏覽器應用、API 或資料庫，不限定部署技術。判斷時先看責任與執行／儲存邊界。

blocks.caption: 表 2｜訂餐案例的分類
rows: 應用程式內的程式模組

paragraphs: 假設餐廳以 Docker 部署訂單 API，訂單增加後開了三個相同實例處理流量。一般 Container Diagram 仍可只畫一個「訂單 API」，描述這種應用的角色與責任。

blocks.caption: 圖 2｜一個應用角色，三個部署實例
blocks.description: 向下連線表示同一角色的部署對應；三個 Docker 實例並列，不互相依序呼叫。這是假設部署範例，C4 Container 不要求使用 Docker。

items.title: C4 Container：訂單 API
items.body: 一種應用程式角色與責任

items.title: Docker 1
items.body: API 實例

items.title: Docker 2
items.body: API 實例

items.title: Docker 3
items.body: API 實例

paragraphs: Container Diagram 回答「包含哪種應用？它負責什麼？」Deployment Diagram 則回答「實際跑在哪裡？執行幾份？如何分配流量？」C4 官方將靜態模型中的 Container 與部署環境中的實例分開描述。

sections.heading: 三、用同一套訂餐系統，從 C1 看到 C4
paragraphs: 以下以同一套假設性的餐廳訂餐系統練習逐步放大；各層名稱與責任須能互相核對。

blocks.heading: C1：System Context — 系統跟誰有關係
paragraphs: 受託開發訂餐系統時，先問誰會使用、系統需要與誰合作，再決定 Python 或 JavaScript。顧客和店員是使用者，支付平台是外部服務。此層先界定 System Boundary：哪些屬於開發範圍，哪些是外部的人或系統；不用展開資料表、函式或伺服器數量。

blocks.caption: 圖 3｜訂餐系統的 C1 外部關係
blocks.description: 顧客／店員 ↔ 訂餐系統 ↔ 外部支付平台，雙向連線表示互動關係；未描述特定通訊協定或執行順序。

items.title: 顧客、餐廳店員
items.body: 系統範圍外的人／角色

items.title: 線上訂餐系統
items.body: 我們正在設計的系統；系統邊界內

items.title: 第三方支付平台
items.body: 系統範圍外的支付服務

blocks.heading: C2：Container — 內部有哪些主要應用？
paragraphs: 打開系統邊界後，辨認前端、後端與資料庫：前端顯示菜單、購物車及訂單；後端檢查訂單、計算金額及處理業務規則；PostgreSQL 保存訂單與商品。這層回答哪些程式會執行、誰負責業務邏輯、資料存在哪裡及如何通訊，仍不需要列出所有函式。

blocks.caption: 圖 4｜訂餐系統的 C2 應用與儲存
blocks.description: 系統內包含前端、API 與 PostgreSQL；顧客與支付平台在外。前端 ↔ API 使用 HTTPS／API，API ↔ 資料庫讀寫資料，API ↔ 外部支付平台通訊；連線是關係，並非所有操作的時序。

items.title: 顧客
items.body: 系統範圍外；使用訂餐前端

items.title: 訂餐前端（Web App）
items.body: 顯示菜單、購物車與訂單

items.title: 訂單後端（API Application）
items.body: 檢查訂單、計算金額、處理業務規則

items.title: 訂單資料庫（PostgreSQL）
items.body: 保存訂單與商品資料

items.title: 第三方支付平台
items.body: 系統範圍外；與訂單後端通訊

blocks.heading: C3：Component — 再放大訂單後端
paragraphs: 假設後端使用 Python，可將責任分為訂單驗證、價格計算、支付協調及資料存取。此時討論的是同一應用程式內部如何分工，不是每個模組各用一台伺服器。

blocks.caption: 圖 5｜同一個訂單後端內的四項分工
blocks.description: 外框代表同一個 API 應用，四個元件平行呈現，沒有順序箭頭。這些只是 Component 示例，不要求四個獨立服務或四個檔案。

items.title: 訂單驗證
items.body: 檢查品項、數量與輸入格式

items.title: 價格計算
items.body: 計算總價、折扣與稅額

items.title: 支付協調
items.body: 向支付平台建立交易

items.title: 資料存取
items.body: 讀取或保存訂單

blocks.heading: C4：Code — 最後看具體程式碼
paragraphs: 再放大訂單驗證模組。下列 Python 3 函式檢查訂單是否為空，以及各品項數量是否大於零。Code 層級關心函式、類別、介面及其關係；單一函式只是此層的入門示例，並非完整 Code Diagram。
本例假設 items 是列表，每個品項皆有數值 quantity。正式驗證還要處理欄位缺漏、資料型別及商品有效性。可將函式存為 order_example.py，執行 python3 order_example.py；下方三個 assert 應無錯誤結束，並顯示 PASS。範例只使用合成資料，不寫入檔案。
回頭對照：C1 說明訂餐系統跟誰互動；C2 列出應用與資料庫；C3 說明後端內部模組；C4 解釋其中的程式實作。四層始終描述同一套系統。

sections.heading: 四、為什麼 Streamlit 的 rules.py 不是 Container？
paragraphs: 本課實際參考程式是一套「本機收件完整性檢核系統」，與前面的假設訂餐平台分開。瀏覽器顯示 Streamlit 介面，Python／Streamlit 程序處理資料、執行檢核並產生報告；rules.py 在同一 Python 程序內載入。

blocks.caption: 圖 6｜本機參考程式的邊界與資料位置
blocks.description: 系統內有瀏覽器前端與 Python／Streamlit 程序；rules.py 和 Session State 嵌在程序內。前端 ↔ 程序由 Streamlit 管理，前端 → 範圍外操作者裝置下載 JSON；不把下載檔畫成系統資料庫。

items.title: 收件人員
items.body: 填寫資料、執行檢核、下載報告

items.title: 瀏覽器中的 Streamlit 前端
items.body: 顯示介面、接收操作

items.title: Python / Streamlit 程序
items.body: 處理資料、執行檢核、產生報告

items.title: rules.py
items.body: 同一程序內部的驗證及匯出邏輯

items.title: Session State
items.body: 暫存工作階段資料；不是持久業務資料庫

items.title: 操作者下載資料夾（系統範圍外）
items.body: 瀏覽器下載 JSON 後，由操作者管理檔案

paragraphs: 這套參考系統沒有持久業務資料庫。前端與 Python 程序的通訊由 Streamlit 框架管理，沒有自行實作的 REST API。圖中只呈現已存在的責任與資料位置。
rules.py 是被同一個 Python 應用載入執行的模組。即使有十幾個驗證函式，也不會自動變成獨立應用。若未來真的拆成獨立執行、由其他程式透過 API 呼叫的驗證服務，再重新評估是否作為另一個 C4 Container；該變更目前仍屬未來設計。

sections.heading: Session State、下載檔與授權分開判斷
paragraphs: Streamlit 的 Session State 可讓某個瀏覽器工作階段的狀態跨應用重新執行保留，但不是持久儲存。關閉或重新整理分頁會使狀態失去；伺服器故障也會清除狀態。它支援工作階段延續，不能承諾資料永久保存。
下載的 JSON 已成為裝置上的持久檔案，由操作者管理。因此「沒有資料庫」不代表資料完全不會留下；檔案保存位置及管理責任仍須記錄。
不同分頁有不同工作階段，也不足以證明完成使用者身分認證（Authentication）、存取授權（Authorization）或安全資料隔離。這些機制須另外設計與驗證，不能從 Session State 或 Container 數量推定。

sections.heading: 五、不同產業如何應用 C4？
paragraphs: 跨產業比較有助於把觀察方法帶到陌生系統。以下案例均為假設架構，沒有宣稱任何特定機構採用這種部署。

blocks.caption: 表 3｜三種產業的相同觀察問題
rows: 醫護人員、醫院系統、外部檢驗機構
醫療前端、後端應用、影像儲存
影像處理、推論、結果呈現
銀行行員、核心銀行系統、外部徵信資料來源
報告前端、報告服務、資料庫
文件解析、規則驗證、報告產製
操作員、生產管理系統、外部供應商
監控前端、設備資料服務、時序資料庫
異常偵測、告警、品質分析

paragraphs: 產業的業務不同，C4 的問題仍相同：誰互動、哪些應用與儲存、內部如何分工。這使它能用於跨領域、語言及框架的架構溝通。

sections.heading: 六、如何畫出可核對的 Container Diagram？
paragraphs: 先查明現有系統真正如何運作，再畫架構。對每個方塊找得到程式或資料位置，對每條連線找得到實際通訊依據。

blocks.caption: 圖 7｜從邊界到真實性的四個盤點階段
blocks.description: 四列依盤點步驟閱讀，並不是程式的執行流程；每一步均須回到實際程式核對。

items.title: 第一階段：確認系統邊界
items.body: 確認誰使用系統、哪些外部系統提供服務、哪些程式由你負責開發；沿用 C1 成果。

items.title: 第二階段：找出主要應用與資料儲存
items.body: 盤點實際執行的前端、後端、工作程序及必要資料儲存；不要把每個檔案當 Container。

items.title: 第三階段：標註責任與通訊
items.body: 方塊寫名稱、用途、主要技術；連線寫誰呼叫誰、傳送何種資料及實際通訊方式。

items.title: 第四階段：檢查真實性與未知事項
items.body: 對應實際執行方式。尚未實作的資料庫、API、認證及遠端部署明列未來規劃。

blocks.heading: architecture.md｜最小架構紀錄
paragraphs: 將圖中關係寫成下列紀錄，再核對每個實際應用、資料位置及通訊關係。圖與文字應互相支持。
模板每行保留原稿中文並附英文對照；另存為 architecture.md 時可依團隊語言調整，保留責任、方向與未驗證狀態。
blocks.code:
# 系統架構 — C4 Container / System architecture — C4 Container

## 系統名稱 / System name
本機收件完整性檢核系統 / Local intake-completeness checker

## 系統邊界內 / Inside the system boundary
- Streamlit 瀏覽器前端：接收操作並顯示結果 / Streamlit browser frontend: receives actions and displays results
- Python / Streamlit 程序：檢核資料並產生報告 / Python / Streamlit process: checks data and generates reports

## 程序內元件 / In-process components
- rules.py：執行欄位驗證及匯出邏輯 / rules.py: field validation and export logic

## 系統邊界外 / Outside the system boundary
- 收件人員：填寫資料、檢查、下載 / Intake worker: enters, checks and downloads data
- 操作者下載資料夾：保存下載報告 / Operator download folder: stores downloaded reports

## 主要通訊 / Main communication
- 前端 ↔ Python：由 Streamlit 框架管理 / Frontend ↔ Python: managed by the Streamlit framework
- 前端 → 操作者裝置：下載 JSON / Frontend → operator device: JSON download

## 儲存 / Storage
- 工作階段資料：Session State / Session data: Session State
- 持久業務資料庫：無 / Persistent business database: none
- 本機下載檔：操作者管理 / Local downloads: managed by the operator

## 部署 / Deployment
- 目前：本機教學原型 / Current: local teaching prototype
- 未驗證：遠端部署、多人存取、正式授權隔離 / Unverified: remote deployment, multi-user access, formal authorization isolation

sections.heading: 七、每次都需要畫滿 C1 到 C4 嗎？
paragraphs: 依 C4 官方說明，多數團隊使用 System Context 與 Container Diagram 已能回答主要問題。內部模組複雜時再補 Component Diagram；程式結構確實需要額外說明時才補 Code Diagram。依溝通問題選擇細節，不為湊齊四張而增加圖。

blocks.caption: 表 4｜依問題選圖
rows: 不清楚系統與外部服務的依賴
不清楚資料在哪個程式被處理
不清楚程式內哪個模組負責
不清楚某段功能如何實作
不清楚服務部署在哪台主機、幾個副本

paragraphs: C4 的四層主要描述靜態結構。若要追蹤按下按鈕後哪些操作先後發生，可補 User Flow、Sequence Diagram 或 C4 Dynamic Diagram。它們回答不同問題，可以互相補充。

sections.heading: 八、理解檢核
paragraphs: 先回答下方三題，再展開參考解析。這是靜態教材的自我檢核，沒有送出、儲存作答或評分服務。完成閱讀與作答不代表已驗收實際系統。
可用文末 C4 Container Diagram 官方範例對照：面對陌生系統時，練習分清系統邊界、應用程式、內部元件、程式碼與部署實例。

exercise.environment: architecture.md與工作坊reference/，紙筆或文字編輯器即可；不需安裝Docker。
steps: 由Context放大系統，標出前端、Python程序及下載位置，為關係寫用途。
將rules.py標為程序內元件，明寫沒有持久資料庫，另列記憶體與下載檔。
用四層問題檢查是否混入不必要細節；將遠端、多人與儲存需求保留為待設計。
exercise.expected: Container草圖與architecture.md文字正本，能對照實際參考程式與資料位置。
exercise.check: Container不等同Docker、檔案或部署實例；沒有虛構資料庫或正式Session安全。
exercise.cleanup: 保留目前與候選部署的區別，不加入真實內部位址或未公開服務資料。

en.summary: Use a hospital analogy and ordering example to understand four C4 views, then check the Streamlit reference to distinguish applications, in-process components, deployment instances, session state and downloads.
objectives: Explain Context, Container, Component and Code as four abstraction levels.
Identify the frontend, Python process and data locations at Container level.
Separate logical architecture, deployment instances and in-process components.

readingGuide.goal: Explain Context, Container, Component and Code as four abstraction levels.
readingGuide.startingPoint: architecture.md and workshop reference/; paper or a text editor is enough. Docker is not required.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand architecture.md and review the checks.
readingGuide.output: A Container sketch and matching architecture.md record checked against the actual reference program and data locations.

sections.heading: Choose a viewing distance for the same system
paragraphs: The C4 model describes software at different viewing distances. Start with the system and its surroundings, then identify its applications, examine how responsibilities are divided within an application, and finally inspect the code. Product managers, developers, architects and AI coding agents can use these views to build a shared understanding of the same system.

Three distinctions guide this lesson. The four levels are views, rather than four computers, services or development steps. A C4 container and a Docker container mean different things. Architecture diagrams must match actual programs, data movement and storage; capabilities that do not yet exist must be labeled as plans.

sections.heading: 1. Understand C4 through a hospital analogy
paragraphs: To understand a large hospital, first consider the hospital and its surroundings, then its departments, the work within each department, and finally specific equipment. Starting with an emergency-room device’s circuit board would not explain how the whole hospital operates. C4 uses a similar change of viewing distance.

blocks.caption: Figure 1｜Four views, from outside to inside
blocks.description: Progressive indentation represents zooming into the subject, not four execution steps. The hospital is an analogy; software levels need not map one-to-one to organizational units.

items.title: C1 — System Context | Farthest view
items.body: Relationships with patients, the health-insurance authority and external laboratories. Who uses the hospital? Which outside organizations does it depend on?

items.title: C2 — Container
items.body: Registration application, medical-record application and laboratory database. What major applications or stores exist, and what is each responsible for?

items.title: C3 — Component
items.body: Booking, scheduling and notification modules within registration. How is work divided inside one application?

items.title: C4 — Code
items.body: Functions that check appointment slots, data models and classes. How is the behavior implemented?

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Questions at four levels
rows: Which applications and data stores make up the system?
How are responsibilities divided within an application?

paragraphs: The levels describe the same system at four degrees of detail; they do not require dividing it into four parts.

sections.heading: 2. What does a C4 container mean?
paragraphs: In software engineering, “container” often brings Docker to mind. In C4, a container is an application or data store at an architectural boundary, such as a browser application, API or database. The term does not prescribe a deployment technology. Identify responsibility and the execution or storage boundary first.

blocks.caption: Table 2 | Classifying the ordering example

paragraphs: Suppose a restaurant deploys its ordering API with Docker and adds three identical running instances as traffic grows. An ordinary container diagram can still show one “Order API,” describing that application’s role and responsibility.

blocks.caption: Figure 2｜One application role, three deployed instances
blocks.description: The downward connection maps a role to its deployment. The three Docker instances are peers, not a call sequence. This hypothetical example does not require C4 containers to use Docker.

items.title: C4 container: Order API
items.body: One application role and responsibility

items.title: Docker 1
items.body: API instance

items.title: Docker 2
items.body: API instance

items.title: Docker 3
items.body: API instance

paragraphs: A container diagram answers “What applications exist, and what does each do?” A deployment diagram answers “Where do they run, how many instances run, and how is traffic distributed?” The official C4 model distinguishes containers in the static model from instances in a deployment environment.

sections.heading: 3. Follow one ordering system from C1 to C4
paragraphs: Use the same hypothetical restaurant ordering system at each level. Names and responsibilities must remain traceable as you zoom in.

blocks.heading: C1: System Context — Who interacts with the system?
paragraphs: When asked to build an ordering system, identify its users and collaborating systems before choosing Python or JavaScript. Customers and restaurant staff are users; the payment platform is an external service. Define the system boundary: what belongs to the development scope, and which people or systems are outside it. Tables, functions and server counts are unnecessary at this level.

blocks.caption: Figure 3｜C1 surroundings of the ordering system
blocks.description: Customers/staff ↔ ordering system ↔ external payment platform. Bidirectional links show interactions, without specifying protocols or execution order.

items.title: Customers and restaurant staff
items.body: People / roles outside the system

items.title: Online ordering system
items.body: The system being designed; inside the system boundary

items.title: Third-party payment platform
items.body: Payment service outside the system

blocks.heading: C2: Container — What major applications are inside?
paragraphs: Open the system boundary and identify its frontend, backend and database. The frontend displays menus, the cart and orders. The backend checks orders, calculates amounts and applies business rules. PostgreSQL stores orders and products. This view explains which applications execute, who owns business logic, where data lives and how applications communicate, without listing every function.

blocks.caption: Figure 4｜C2 applications and storage
blocks.description: The boundary encloses the frontend, API and PostgreSQL; the customer and payment platform are outside. Frontend ↔ API uses HTTPS/API, API ↔ database reads/writes data, and API ↔ external payment platform exchanges payment information. Links are relationships, not a universal sequence.

items.title: Customer
items.body: Outside the system; uses the ordering frontend

items.title: Ordering frontend (Web App)
items.body: Displays menus, cart and orders

items.title: Order backend (API Application)
items.body: Checks orders, calculates amounts and applies business rules

items.title: Order database (PostgreSQL)
items.body: Stores orders and product data

items.title: Third-party payment platform
items.body: Outside the system; communicates with the order backend

blocks.heading: C3: Component — Zoom into the order backend
paragraphs: Suppose the backend uses Python. Its responsibilities can include order validation, pricing, payment coordination and data access. This view divides work within one application; it does not assign a server to every module.

blocks.caption: Figure 5｜Four responsibilities inside one order backend
blocks.description: The boundary represents one API application. Four peer components have no sequence arrows. These are component examples, not a requirement for four separate services or files.

items.title: Order validation
items.body: Checks items, quantities and input format

items.title: Pricing
items.body: Calculates totals, discounts and tax

items.title: Payment coordination
items.body: Creates a transaction with the payment platform

items.title: Data access
items.body: Reads or saves orders

blocks.heading: C4: Code — Finally inspect the code
paragraphs: Zoom into order validation. The following Python 3 function checks for an empty order and verifies that every quantity is positive. The code level concerns functions, classes, interfaces and their relationships. One function is an introductory illustration at this level, rather than a complete code diagram.

This example assumes items is a list and every item has a numeric quantity. Production validation must also handle missing fields, types and valid products. Save it as order_example.py and run python3 order_example.py. All three assertions should finish without errors and print PASS. The example uses synthetic data and writes no files.

Compare the views: C1 identifies the ordering system’s interactions; C2 identifies applications and the database; C3 divides work within the backend; C4 explains the implementation. All four views describe the same system.

sections.heading: 4. Why is rules.py not a Streamlit container?
paragraphs: The course reference program is a local intake-completeness checker, separate from the hypothetical ordering platform. The browser displays Streamlit’s interface. The Python/Streamlit process handles data, performs checks and produces reports. It loads rules.py within the same Python process.

blocks.caption: Figure 6｜Boundaries and data locations in the local reference
blocks.description: The boundary contains the browser frontend and Python/Streamlit process, with rules.py and Session State nested in that process. Streamlit manages frontend ↔ process communication. Frontend → operator device downloads JSON outside the boundary; the downloaded file is not a system database.

items.title: Intake worker
items.body: Enters data, runs checks and downloads reports

items.title: Streamlit browser frontend
items.body: Displays the interface and receives actions

items.title: Python / Streamlit process
items.body: Processes data, checks completeness and generates reports

items.title: rules.py
items.body: Validation and export logic inside the same process

items.title: Session State
items.body: Temporary session data; not a persistent business database

items.title: Operator download folder (outside the system)
items.body: The browser downloads JSON; the operator manages the resulting files

paragraphs: The reference has no persistent business database. Streamlit manages communication between the frontend and Python process; the application does not implement its own REST API. The diagram shows existing responsibilities and data locations.

rules.py is a module loaded and executed by the same Python application. A dozen validation functions do not make it an independent application. If validation is later extracted into an independently executing service called by other applications over an API, reassess whether it should be another C4 container. That change remains a future design.

sections.heading: Distinguish Session State, downloads and authorization
paragraphs: Streamlit Session State preserves a browser session’s state across application reruns, but is not persistent storage. Closing or reloading the tab loses that state; a server crash also clears it. It supports session continuity without promising permanent retention.

A downloaded JSON report becomes a persistent file on the device under the operator’s control. “No database” therefore does not mean “no data remains.” Record the file location and management responsibility.

Separate sessions in separate tabs do not establish authentication, authorization or secure data isolation. Those mechanisms require their own design and verification. Session State and container counts cannot prove them.

sections.heading: 5. Apply C4 across industries
paragraphs: Comparing industries helps transfer the viewing method to unfamiliar systems. Every architecture below is hypothetical; none describes a particular organization’s actual deployment.

blocks.caption: Table 3 | The same viewing questions in three industries
rows: Clinical staff, hospital systems, external laboratories
Clinical frontend, backend application, image store
Bank staff, core banking system, external credit-information sources
Document parsing, rule validation, report generation
Monitoring frontend, equipment-data service, time-series database

paragraphs: Business domains differ, but the C4 questions remain the same: who interacts, which applications and stores exist, and how internal work is divided. This supports architectural communication across domains, languages and frameworks.

sections.heading: 6. Build a container diagram that can be checked
paragraphs: Inspect how the existing system actually works before drawing it. Each box should correspond to a program or data location, and each connection should have evidence of actual communication.

blocks.caption: Figure 7｜Four review stages, from boundary to reality
blocks.description: Read the four rows as review steps, not application execution. Verify each step against the actual program.

items.title: Stage 1: Confirm the system boundary
items.body: Identify users, external service providers and programs you own; reuse the C1 findings.

items.title: Stage 2: Identify major applications and data stores
items.body: Inventory actual frontends, backends, workers and necessary stores. Do not classify every file as a container.

items.title: Stage 3: Label responsibilities and communication
items.body: Give each box a name, purpose and main technology. Label who calls whom, what data moves and the actual communication mechanism.

items.title: Stage 4: Check reality and unknowns
items.body: Match the runtime. Explicitly label unimplemented databases, APIs, authentication and remote deployment as future plans.

blocks.heading: architecture.md | Minimal architecture record
paragraphs: Write the diagram’s relationships into the following record, then verify every actual application, data location and communication relationship. The diagram and text should support each other.

Each template line retains the supplied Chinese and includes an English equivalent. When saving architecture.md, choose the team’s language while preserving responsibilities, directions and unverified status.
blocks.code:
# 系統架構 — C4 Container / System architecture — C4 Container

## 系統名稱 / System name
本機收件完整性檢核系統 / Local intake-completeness checker

## 系統邊界內 / Inside the system boundary
- Streamlit 瀏覽器前端：接收操作並顯示結果 / Streamlit browser frontend: receives actions and displays results
- Python / Streamlit 程序：檢核資料並產生報告 / Python / Streamlit process: checks data and generates reports

## 程序內元件 / In-process components
- rules.py：執行欄位驗證及匯出邏輯 / rules.py: field validation and export logic

## 系統邊界外 / Outside the system boundary
- 收件人員：填寫資料、檢查、下載 / Intake worker: enters, checks and downloads data
- 操作者下載資料夾：保存下載報告 / Operator download folder: stores downloaded reports

## 主要通訊 / Main communication
- 前端 ↔ Python：由 Streamlit 框架管理 / Frontend ↔ Python: managed by the Streamlit framework
- 前端 → 操作者裝置：下載 JSON / Frontend → operator device: JSON download

## 儲存 / Storage
- 工作階段資料：Session State / Session data: Session State
- 持久業務資料庫：無 / Persistent business database: none
- 本機下載檔：操作者管理 / Local downloads: managed by the operator

## 部署 / Deployment
- 目前：本機教學原型 / Current: local teaching prototype
- 未驗證：遠端部署、多人存取、正式授權隔離 / Unverified: remote deployment, multi-user access, formal authorization isolation

sections.heading: 7. Do you need all four levels every time?
paragraphs: The official C4 guidance says that system context and container diagrams are sufficient for most teams. Add a component diagram when internal modules need explanation, and a code diagram when the code structure needs further detail. Choose detail for the communication question rather than drawing four diagrams merely to complete a set.

blocks.caption: Table 4 | Choose a diagram for the question
rows: Which external services does the system depend on?
Which module inside the application owns the work?
Which hosts run the service, and how many replicas exist?

paragraphs: The four C4 levels mainly describe static structure. To follow what happens after a button is pressed, supplement them with a user flow, sequence diagram or C4 dynamic diagram. These views answer different questions and can complement one another.

sections.heading: 8. Check your understanding
paragraphs: Answer the three questions below before opening the reference explanations. This static self-check has no submission, answer storage or grading service. Reading and answering do not establish practical acceptance of an actual system.
Compare the official C4 container-diagram example linked in the sources. For an unfamiliar system, practice separating its boundary, applications, internal components, code and deployment instances.

exercise.environment: architecture.md and workshop reference/; paper or a text editor is enough. Docker is not required.
steps: Zoom into the Context system, identify the frontend, Python process and download location, and label relationship purposes.
Mark rules.py as in-process responsibility; explicitly record no persistent database and separate memory from downloads.
Use the four levels to remove unnecessary detail; keep remote, shared-user and storage needs pending design.
exercise.expected: A Container sketch and matching architecture.md record checked against the actual reference program and data locations.
exercise.check: Do not equate a container with Docker, a file or an instance. Invent neither a database nor established session security.
exercise.cleanup: Keep current and candidate deployments distinct. Include no actual internal addresses or nonpublic service details.

zh.prompt: 某銀行有一套 Python 報告產製系統。parser.py、validator.py、exporter.py 由同一個 Python 程序載入執行。Container Diagram 應如何表示？
options: 畫成一個 Python 應用，三個功能屬於內部元件
因為是 Python，所以不需要架構圖
rationales: 三個檔案由同一程序載入，檔案數不足以證明獨立應用邊界。
同一 Python 應用承擔報告責任，三項功能可在 Component 視角展開。
架構溝通是否需要圖取決於問題，與使用 Python 無關。

en.prompt: A bank’s Python report system loads parser.py, validator.py and exporter.py in the same Python process. How should its container diagram represent this?
options: Draw one Python application, with the three responsibilities as internal components
Python applications do not need architecture diagrams
rationales: Three files loaded by one process do not establish independent application boundaries.
One Python application owns report generation; its three responsibilities can be expanded in a component view.
Whether a diagram helps depends on the communication question, not the use of Python.

zh.prompt: 某醫療 AI 推論 API 部署成五個 Docker 實例，由負載平衡器分配請求。這在 C4 中代表什麼？
options: Docker 數量決定 Component 數量
邏輯上可能是一個 C4 Container，部署上有五個實例
rationales: 實例數量屬部署視角，不能直接當成不同應用的數量。
Component 依應用內部責任劃分，不由 Docker 數量決定。
同一 API 的多個部署實例仍可對應同一個邏輯應用；部署圖再標五個實例與負載平衡器。

en.prompt: A medical AI inference API runs as five Docker instances behind a load balancer. What does this mean in C4?
options: There must be five C4 containers
The Docker count determines the component count
It may be one logical C4 container with five deployed instances
rationales: Instance counts belong to deployment and do not directly count distinct applications.
Components divide responsibilities within an application; Docker counts do not determine them.
Several instances of the same API can map to one logical application. A deployment diagram can show the five instances and load balancer.

zh.prompt: 某 Streamlit 網站讓十個人同時開啟，各自有 Session State。是否足以證明已有安全的資料授權隔離？
options: 是，不同 Session 就等於正式授權
否，仍需要驗證身分、授權與資料隔離設計
是，只要沒有資料庫就不會有資料外洩
rationales: 工作階段範圍與正式存取權限是不同機制。
須另外驗證使用者身分、哪些資料可被誰存取，以及實際隔離行為。
記憶體、下載檔或其他輸出同樣可能含資料，沒有資料庫不構成無外洩保證。

en.prompt: Ten people open a Streamlit site with separate Session State. Does this establish secure data-authorization isolation?
options: No; identity, authorization and data-isolation design still require verification
Yes; without a database, data cannot leak
rationales: Session scope and formal access permissions are different mechanisms.
Verify user identity, who can access which data and the actual isolation behavior separately.
Memory, downloads and other outputs can contain data; the absence of a database cannot guarantee that data never leaks.
